plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 112 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Carney St, Hwy 16, Hwy 97, Hwy 97 (Cariboo Hwy S).
Park: 53.1763, -122.46224, pull off on Amend 1 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 250 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 32 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2010 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-2, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AB-deer-drive-0001.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 5-2: about 32,437 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.31 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 32 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
